critical_code_review_comments: PhotoMarkupEditor.jsx: applyZoom clamps to [1,5] — no zoom-out below 100% (by design). Comment note: markup-zoom-out button uses divisor 1.5, which will simply cap at 1 (not a bug, matches spec).

JobMap.jsx focusItemId is captured only ONCE from initial searchParams via useState initializer (line 565). If user edits two items in a row without a full reload, focus is preserved from the first ?focus=… — but since navigate() to /map?focus=<id> triggers a fresh render on this page-level component, useSearchParams reflects the new value in the effect deps (poles/underground). This works today but is fragile; consider reading searchParams.get('focus') directly in the effect for robustness.
PhotoMarkupEditor.jsx is now 2213 lines — recommend splitting toolbar/canvas/dialog into subcomponents (already flagged in earlier iterations).
